elena (acme-corp): Hey team — after upgrading our app to the newest python client (we pulled latest via pip), we've started seeing a ton of duplicate charges and occasional 500s when sending batch requests. Anyone else?

sam (support): Sorry to hear that, elena. Can you paste the pip package version you upgraded to and a small repro? :eyes:

elena (acme-corp): Sure — pip shows `redwood-inference==1.27.1`. Repro is straightforward: we submit a batched generate with idempotency header set in middleware, but logs show the header missing on repeated attempts. Example trace below.

elena (acme-corp): ```
Request headers before send: {"Idempotency-Key": "abc-123", "Authorization": "Bearer ***"}
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
--- retrying ---
Request headers on retry: {"authorization": "Bearer ***"}  # idempotency header gone
```

raj (sdk-eng): Hmm. That smells like a header normalization change in the client. We changed internal request piping in 1.27 to unify header case, but shouldn't drop user-set headers. Can you share the minimal client call you run?

elena (acme-corp): Code: ```python
from redwood import Client
cli = Client(api_key=...)
resp = cli.generate.batch([prompt_list], headers={"Idempotency-Key":"abc-123"})
```

sam (support): Thanks. We're seeing two customer reports that map to 1.27.x only. Quick mitigation: pin to 1.26.3 in requirements.txt and restart workers. Can you try that and confirm if duplicates stop?

elena (acme-corp): Pinning to 1.26.3 stopped the duplicate charges within 30 minutes, yes. Still getting a few transient 500s but no double-billing.

raj (sdk-eng): Good data point — that indicates a regression introduced between 1.26.3 and 1.27.0. I already opened an internal issue referencing this thread. Likely root cause: header dict merging path renamed `headers` -> `_internal_headers` in the transport layer; we missed preserving user headers on retry.

infra-bot: New issue created: SDK-944 (regression: idempotency header dropped on retry in 1.27+). Assigned to raj.

ops (oncall): Re: billing — we've flagged customer’s account for manual refund/credit while we triage. Ops ticket OP-1827.

raj (sdk-eng): Immediate next steps: 1) Add a hotfix to restore header preservation on retry and cut 1.27.2, 2) add an integration test that asserts Idempotency-Key survives transient 5xx and retry attempts, 3) publish advisory recommending pin to 1.26.3 for affected customers until patch is out.

sam (support): I'll update the support ticket and send a short note to customers who reported this recommending pin and telling them we're rolling a patch. Template: "If you rely on Idempotency-Key or custom headers for billing idempotency, pin to 1.26.3 until 1.27.2 is released."

elena (acme-corp): Thanks — can you also confirm whether this could affect streaming endpoints / websocket clients? We have some mixed workloads.

raj (sdk-eng): Good question. The change only touched the HTTP transport used by both sync/async clients; streaming path uses a separate websocket transport — not impacted. We'll run a quick smoke on streaming to be sure.

sam (support): ETA for patch?

raj (sdk-eng): I'll aim to have a PR by EOD (UTC) and cut 1.27.2 in the morning after a quick CI run. If the fix looks risky we'll roll forward with 1.27.2 as a patch release.

infra-bot: CI job: sdk-unit-tests passed on branch fix/sdk-944. Integration tests queued.

sam (support): Great. Elena — as a temporary repro/logging suggestion, could you enable request-level debug in the client and paste the transport dump? `Client(..., debug=True)` should show full headers and retry attempts.

elena (acme-corp): Will do and attach logs to the support ticket. Appreciate the quick response. :thumbsup:

raj (sdk-eng): Also adding a note to the release notes and changelog to call out the regression and the recommended pin. We should avoid customers automatically upgrading across minor versions for now — will update semver guidance in docs.

sam (support): Marking thread resolved for customer triage steps. Will follow up once 1.27.2 is published.

elena (acme-corp): Thanks everyone.

(ended)
